datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = []
}

model Article {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  slug        String    @unique
  title       String
  description String
  body        String
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  tagList     Tag[]
  author      User      @relation("UserArticles", fields: [authorId], onDelete: Cascade, references: [id])
  authorId    Int
  favoritedBy User[]    @relation("UserFavorites")
  comments    Comment[]
}

model Comment {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  body      String
  article   Article  @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  articleId Int
  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  Int
  editedAt  DateTime?
}

model Tag {
  id       Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name     String    @unique
  articles Article[]
}

model User {
  id         Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  email      String    @unique
  username   String    @unique
  password   String
  image      String?   @default("https://api.realworld.io/images/smiley-cyrus.jpeg")
  bio        String?
  articles   Article[] @relation("UserArticles")
  favorites  Article[] @relation("UserFavorites")
  followedBy User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  following  User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  comments   Comment[]
  demo       Boolean   @default(false)
}

- getCommentsByArticle leaves out comments that have the timestamp set.

The spec is written to `specs/feature-3-soft-delete.md`. It names eight rules and their sources and gives no rule values. The notes and the code disagree in several places, and I followed the policy notes and the code where they conflict.

**Disagreements and what I followed**

1. **Delete behavior.** `code-comment-ownership.md` says deleting removes the row. `policy-soft-delete.md` says it sets a deletion timestamp and keeps the row. I followed the policy, since this feature is the change to that behavior.
2. **Error shape.** `ops-runbook.md` asks new errors to use the errors-by-field body. `policy-error-response.md` asks for an error object with a code and a message. I followed the policy because it is the explicit rule for error responses. The runbook may need updating, and you should confirm this choice.
3. **Editing field.** `code-comment-model.md` says the Comment model has no `editedAt` field. `app/src/prisma/schema.prisma` line 35 has one, and `deleteComment`'s neighbor `editComment` already uses it. I followed the code. The note is stale.
4. **Migration count.** `code-migrations.md` says there are four migrations. The folder has five, including `20261030120000_comment_edited_at`. I followed the folder.

**Choices I made that you may want to change**

- The not-found and not-author cases keep the existing 404 status from `deleteComment`. Their body follows the new error object rather than the current empty body. The spec does not give the exact error code string, so the Builder will need one.
- The spec leaves the deletion timestamp's name open. `policy-soft-delete.md` names the field `deletedAt`, so I used that name in the migration, which the Builder will confirm.
- `getCommentsByArticle` in `article.service.ts` currently has no filter for deleted comments. The spec says to add one.
